channel.title: XN Ministry of HR Official Feed

item.title: Xanadu Ministry updates maternity leave to 16 weeks
item.description: The Ministry of Human Resources has issued an amendment extending statutory maternity leave from 14 to 16 weeks, effective 1 January 2027.

item.title: New social insurance contribution rates effective Q1 2027
item.description: Revised contribution rates for Q1 2027: employee from 8% to 9%, employer from 12% to 13%.

item.title: Employment Law Amendment: termination notice period extended to 60 days
item.description: Parliament passed the Employment Law Amendment extending mandatory termination notice for 5+ year employees from 30 to 60 days.

item.title: Pension fund reform bill passes second parliamentary reading
item.description: Pension Fund Reform Bill passed second reading. Mandatory pension enrollment for all employees over 18.
